services.desc: We aim to offer our students the most competitive PA skydiving prices with no hidden fees attached. While reviewing our pricing, we ask that you keep in mind that skydiving is an expensive sport. To provide our guests with a safe, high quality skydiving experience, we must meticulously maintain our aircraft, skydiving gear, and facilities in addition to employing highly experienced instructors. Our skydiving prices are a reflection of the quality of equipment we use and the experience level of our instructors. Good Skydiving is not cheap, Cheap skydiving is not good. services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: For more than 30 years, Skydive PA has been providing quality skydiving to both new and experienced skydivers in the greater Pittsburgh, PA area. We are the only full-service dropzone serving Western Pennsylvania. USPA licensed skydivers of all skill levels and disciplines are invited to join us for fun jumping all season long. Skydive Pennsylvania is located at the Grove City Airport in Mercer, PA. We offer the largest skydiving flight line in the area and the only turbine aircraft serving Pittsburgh and the surrounding areas.
